title: FastF1 Session Lap Count Leaderboard
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fastf1:session lap_count=*
| stats sum(lap_count) as total_value, avg(lap_count) as avg_value by session_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks session type values by total and average lap count across FastF1 session events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `lap_count` values for each FastF1 session event and review total and average lap count by session type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total lap count.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which session type shows the biggest lap count numbers in your FastF1 session data.
